title: New melon-based bonemeal farm
summary: A new flying-machine bonemeal farm based on melons was released alongside a community build submission opportunity.
description: TheySix released another farm design and invited builders to submit aesthetic builds and farms for possible future content.

body.text: A melon-based bonemeal farm using a flying machine was released as an alternative design for players and servers.
Players were invited to submit aesthetic builds and farms that could be featured in future content.
